events.verdict: Siakam (IND) brings his hand towards the ball and the contact with Harris' (DET) off-arm is marginal.
Duren (DET) briefly grasps Jackson's (IND) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
Walker (IND) moves to LeVert's (DET) side and the contact that occurs is the result of LeVert bringing his leg out towards Walker.
Nembhard (IND) loses control of the ball on his own prior to any contact from Cunningham (DET).
Harris (DET) moves laterally into Siakam's (IND) path and initiates body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Duren (DET) makes contact with Jackson's (IND) head and affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Mathurin (IND) avoids making contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm as he defends the shot.
Jackson (IND) establishes himself in Cunningham's (DET) path prior to the contact.
Nembhard (IND) does not bring both hands to the ball when he brings his dribble to a pause.
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Cunningham (DET).

Walker (IND) initiates contact with LeVert's (DET) arm that affects his shot attempt.
